name: commit-defender
description: AI-powered pre-commit code review with inline suggestions

commitDefender.runnerMode.description: How to run commit-defender: 'docker' (requires Docker Desktop) or 'local' (requires the commit_defender Python package installed on the host).

commitDefender.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python executable that has commit_defender installed. Used when runnerMode is 'local'. Can be a virtualenv path, e.g. /path/to/.venv/bin/python.

commitDefender.image.description: Docker image to use for analysis. Used when runnerMode is 'docker'.

commitDefender.timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the analysis to complete.

commitDefender.runOnStage.description: Automatically re-analyze when the git index changes (files are staged).

commitDefender.homeEnvFile.description: Absolute path to credentials .env file. Defaults to ~/.commit-defender.env. Used when runnerMode is 'docker'.
